Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground meat (beef, pork, or chicken)
- 1/4 cup chopped onions
- 1/4 cup chopped carrots
- 1/4 cup chopped celery
- 1/4 cup chopped green onions
- 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
- 1/4 teaspoon ginger powder
- 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder
- 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder
- 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder
- 1/4 teaspoon paprika
- 1/4 teaspoon chili powder
- 1/4 teaspoon sugar
- 1/4 cup cornstarch
- 1/2 cup cold water
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, mix together the ground meat, onions, carrots, celery, green onions, garlic, salt, black pepper, ginger powder, white pepper powder, five-spice powder, cumin powder, paprika, chili powder, sugar, and cornstarch.
2. Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan or wok over medium-high heat.
3. Once the oil is hot, use a tablespoon to scoop the meat mixture into small balls and drop them into the hot oil. Fry the egg rolls in batches until they are golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
4. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the fried egg rolls to a paper towel-lined plate to drain off any excess oil.
5. Serve the fried egg rolls hot with your favorite dipping sauce.

Enjoy your delicious homemade egg rolls!
